experiment: 20261112-132-int-mlp-e2e, amendment A-3 (issue #150 part B, lane resume150br2)
kind: resume of PR #138's registered run, abliterated leg, layers 31 to 63, final norm, lm_head and the registered bar, from the state after layer 30 that PR #167 regenerated and hashed

commits.code_at_run: 1960ec5f81b4ad9fd092bed7bbaa7571a56fb4cf (PR #138's run commit, executed from a checkout of that commit, unchanged)
commits.prereg_amendment: aa9b55f (A-3, committed alone before the run)

stock.used: none in this resume (layers 0 to 16 are inside the starting state); the code's stock Ckpt object reads only the index and header

checkpoints.note: weights read into memory by HTTP range request as in PR #138, never written to disk

toolchain.blas: scipy-openblas 0.3.31.dev (OpenBLAS 0.3.31.dev  USE64BITINT DYNAMIC_ARCH NO_AFFINITY Haswell MAX_THREADS=64)
toolchain.threads: OMP_NUM_THREADS = OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS = MKL_NUM_THREADS = 6 in the main process (entry script, as PR #138's run_mlp.sh); 6 spawned head workers with 1 BLAS thread each (e2e.make_pool, unchanged)
toolchain.long_double: x87 80-bit (scaled_head.py relies on it, x86-64 only)
toolchain.launch: systemd user unit -> supervisor/watchdog (polls 2 s) -> flock bigmem.lock fp-heavy.sh taskset -c 6-11 /usr/bin/time -v -o run.time python3 entry -> exec mlp_e2e.py run <state> <runs> full (same pid)

hardware.cpu: AMD EPYC-Rome Processor, 16 vCPU KVM VM (results.yaml key cpu-epyc-rome-kvm-16), shared with other work and loaded
hardware.units_note: Linux kB in /proc and time -v are KiB; disk_free_gb in watchdog.log is bytes / 1024^3 (GiB)

repeats: one deterministic run is the registered run; XM18#2 (p01, p04, p09) is the in-run determinism check
data_on_disk: state outside the repository; start and end sha256 in state-start-sha256.json and state-end-sha256.json
